checks.name: A1h (audit_net A1, the admin out of the world) admin BRING still moves people, exactly to the spot, and they carry on from there
A1b (the HQ2 rule) with a joined admin standing there, BRING puts him beside it: >= 44 px from the admin, told by tp, and he carries on from there
M4h (audit_net M4, the admin out of the world) a short hop through a wall is refused: he stays on his side
R2h (audit_net R2, nobody on the spawn point) a dead player can respawn: back at the spawn point, alive, no correction
R2b (the HQ2 rule) someone stands on the spawn point: the respawn lands on the nearest free spot (>= 44 px from them, within 240 px of the spawn point), alive
MT1h (audit_net2 MT1, the admin out of the world) real move.js traces by an ordinary client: no correction, the server ends where the client does
